# Sitemap Extractor

The Apify actor [`apify/sitemap-extractor`](https://apify.com/apify/sitemap-extractor) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.1.32** (module version **0.2.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

This Apify Actor extracts all URLs from a website's sitemaps and checks their status codes via lightweight HTTP requests. It provides a clean list of valid links, acting as an ideal pre-processor to ensure your larger crawling projects target only active URLs.

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.0005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/sitemap-extractor) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-sitemap-extractor@0.2.0#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Telo.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

| `maxCrawlingDepth` | integer |  | `0` | Max crawling depth — Specifies how many sitemap levels the crawler will descend. This value is a safeguard against infinite crawling depths for misconfigured scrapers. If set to 1, will process only the root sitemap. If set to 0, there is no limit. |

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
